statements.text:
-- Public read-only views for the local HTML sample review app.
--
-- These views expose only the prepared 200-row sample batches through the
-- default Supabase REST schema. They do not expose full review tables and do
-- not allow decision writes.

create or replace view public.match_candidate_queue_sample
with (security_invoker = true)
as
select
  queue_id,
  source_batch_id,
  source_channel,
  source_row_no,
  channel_product_code,
  channel_option_code,
  channel_product_name,
  channel_option_name,
  channel_seller_code,
  channel_stock,
  channel_status,
  best_sellpia_product_code,
  best_sellpia_sku_code,
  best_sellpia_product_name,
  best_sellpia_option_name,
  match_tier,
  match_score,
  match_reason,
  duplicate_candidate_count,
  duplicate_risk,
  review_required,
  recommended_action,
  source_candidate_key,
  created_at,
  updated_at
from review.match_candidate_queue
where source_batch_id in ('sample_smartstore_100', 'sample_makeshop_100')

create or replace view public.match_candidate_details_sample
with (security_invoker = true)
as
select
  d.detail_id,
  d.queue_id,
  d.candidate_rank,
  d.sellpia_product_code,
  d.sellpia_sku_code,
  d.sellpia_product_name,
  d.sellpia_option_name,
  d.match_score,
  d.match_reason,
  d.risk_flags,
  d.created_at
from review.match_candidate_details d
join review.match_candidate_queue q
  on q.queue_id = d.queue_id
where q.source_batch_id in ('sample_smartstore_100', 'sample_makeshop_100')
grant select on public.match_candidate_queue_sample to anon, authenticated
grant select on public.match_candidate_details_sample to anon, authenticated
